correctness.rationale: Radial angular integration produces norm I_alpha=(pi^d/p)alpha!/Gamma(k+d)*Gamma((k+d)/p). Distinct H e_alpha torus weights are mutually orthogonal, giving exact squared singular values (j+1)r_{k+1}-j r_k. Gamma-ratio asymptotics uniform in 0<=j<=k give p^{-1/p}k^{-(1-1/p)}(1-(1-1/p)j/k+O(k^{-1})); the angular term is strictly bounded below by 1/p. Counting lattice points with multiplicity binomial(k-j+d-2,d-2), uniform cutoff and a small-k exclusion yields beta integral C_{d,p}. Monotone rearrangement yields s_n and logarithmic residue. Independent high-precision gamma checks at k=400 and rational integral d=p=2 verify 31/640. Finite checks supplement the analytic asymptotic proof.
